entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-04
entry.content:
Issues

  • Breaking change: PATCH no longer accepts Content-Type application/json #65325
  • Healthcheck log message with redundant HealthCheckName (both in log message and in log scope) #65323
  • Extraneous lines in new webapi project http file #65317

    Infrastructure

    Infrastructure
